content: When overriding table/tbody/tr/td with display:block/flex for responsive layouts, the key pitfall is that adding a media-query block that reverts the display values back to table-row or table-cell removes the flex behavior. td is inherently display:table-cell which overrides flex-item behavior unless explicitly overridden. The correct pattern is to always keep the table elements as display:block/flex and only add flex-wrap or width changes in media queries — never revert to table-* display values.
